job.title: Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job title: Infrastructure Engineer (SC Cleared) - VMware / Omnissa Horizon
Day rate: £425 per day - Inside IR35
Duration: 6 months initially
Location: Nottingham - Hybrid
Start date: ASAP
Security Clearance: SC Cleared

Role
We are looking for an experienced SC Cleared Infrastructure Engineer with VMware / Omnissa Horizon platform expertise.
This role will primarily focus on technical project delivery and platform-level support, with the flexibility to assist with BAU activities when required.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Act as the Subject Matter Expert for VMware / Omnissa Horizon and virtualisation technologies
  • Support technical projects across design, implementation, testing and transition into BAU
  • Provide hands-on troubleshooting and platform support
  • Support BAU operations and technical fixes when required
  • Collaborate with client teams and third-party suppliers on technical delivery
  • Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to wider teams
Skills Required
  • Strong VMware / Omnissa Horizon expertise - essential
  • VMware / vSphere
  • Windows Server 2012 R2, 2016 and 2019
  • HPE server infrastructure
  • Active Directory
  • Infrastructure troubleshooting
  • Basic networking and data centre experience
Other
  • Requirement to be on call 1 week every 4 weeks (remote, with rate uplift)
